Party: parting and quiet companions.script: (function(){const P=check({type:'npc-health',npc:'anyPartyNPC'})||{};const names=Object.keys(P);if(!names.length){if(storage.pq)storage.pq={};skip=true;return;}const cb=check({type:'npc-in-combat',npc:'anySceneNPC'}),fight=cb===true||(cb&&typeof cb==='object'&&Object.values(cb).some(v=>v===true));const A=check({type:'action-text'});const al=String(Array.isArray(A)?(A[A.length-1]||''):(A||'')).toLowerCase();const low=(String(check({type:'story-text'})||'')+' '+al).toLowerCase();const toks=n=>n.replace(/ \([^)]*\)$/,'').toLowerCase().split(/\s+/).filter(w=>w.length>=3);const hit=(n,t)=>toks(n).some(w=>new RegExp('\\b'+w+'\\b').test(t));const PART=/\b(see you( later| around| tomorrow| in (class|homeroom|the morning))?|goodbye|bye|good night|part(ing)? ways|split up|go ahead without me|you (don'?t|do not) (need|have) to (follow|come)|(go|going|head|heading|walk|walking|set off|setting off|wander|leave|leaving)( off| out)?( on)? (alone|on my own|by myself|my own way))\b/;const LEAVE=/\b(part(ing)? ways|split up|go ahead without me|you (don'?t|do not) (need|have) to (follow|come)|(go|going|head|heading|walk|walking|set off|setting off|wander|leave|leaving)( off| out)?( on)? (alone|on my own|by myself|my own way))\b/;let parting=!fight&&PART.test(al),tgt=new Set(),all=false;if(parting){const ms=[...al.matchAll(new RegExp(PART.source,'g'))];const dist=n=>{let best=1e9;for(const w of toks(n)){const re=new RegExp('\\b'+w+'\\b','g');let m;while((m=re.exec(al))!==null){if(/with $/.test(al.slice(Math.max(0,m.index-5),m.index)))continue;for(const p of ms){const e=p.index+p[0].length,d=m.index>=e?m.index-e:p.index-(m.index+w.length);if(/[.!?]/.test(al.slice(Math.min(e,m.index+w.length),Math.max(p.index,m.index))))continue;if(Math.max(0,d)<best)best=Math.max(0,d);}}}return best;};const sc=check({type:'npc-in-scene',npc:'anySceneNPC'})||{};let nd=1e9;for(const n of Object.keys(sc))if(sc[n]&&!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(P,n))nd=Math.min(nd,dist(n));for(const n of names){const d=dist(n);if(d<=20&&d<nd)tgt.add(n);}const pos=n=>{const r=[];for(const w of toks(n)){const re=new RegExp('\\b'+w+'\\b','g');let m;while((m=re.exec(al))!==null)if(!/with $/.test(al.slice(Math.max(0,m.index-5),m.index)))r.push([m.index,m.index+w.length]);}return r;};let grew=tgt.size>0;while(grew){grew=false;const tp=[...tgt].flatMap(pos);for(const n of names){if(tgt.has(n))continue;if(pos(n).some(a=>tp.some(b=>{const g=a[0]>=b[1]?a[0]-b[1]:b[0]-a[1];return g>=0&&g<=6&&/^(, ?| and |,? and )$/.test(al.slice(Math.min(a[1],b[1]),Math.max(a[0],b[0])));}))){tgt.add(n);grew=true;}}}if(!tgt.size&&nd>20&&LEAVE.test(al))all=true;}const stay=n=>toks(n).some(w=>new RegExp('with '+w+'\\b').test(al));const Q=storage.pq||(storage.pq={});const out=[];for(const n of names){const b=n.replace(/ \([^)]*\)$/,'');if(parting&&(tgt.has(n)||(all&&!stay(n)))){out.push([n,b,'parted']);continue;}if(fight||hit(n,low)){Q[n]=0;continue;}Q[n]=(Q[n]||0)+1;if(Q[n]>=5)out.push([n,b,'quiet']);}for(const k of Object.keys(Q))if(names.indexOf(k)<0)delete Q[k];if(!out.length){skip=true;return;}for(const x of out){effects.push({type:'npc-in-party',npc:x[0],operator:'set',value:false});delete Q[x[0]];}const who=out.map(x=>x[1]),many=who.length>1;effects.push({type:'story',instruction:'Narrator only: '+who.join(', ')+(many?' have':' has')+' gone their own way and '+(many?'are':'is')+' no longer with the player character: do not write them along unless they visibly come back.'});log('party: left '+out.map(x=>x[1]+' ('+x[2]+')').join(', '));})();
